messages:
Samir Desai: Quick flag — Horizon (SMB) saw WAU drop ~50% after initial onboarding. Renewal in 18 days. Thinking a compact 'lightweight rehab' play: short triage + reversible safety config + enablement. Thoughts?

Leah Park: Can we confirm which step they drop off?

Tom Hsu: Funnel shows most drop at bulk import -> vectorize. They also have a few large multipart uploads causing client retries.

Nora Bell: Telemetry: no 5xx, but retry storms and token spikes. They skipped streaming guide in onboarding.

Samir Desai: Proposed lightweight play: 1) 15-min triage call (PM + eng) 2) temp safety config (cap concurrency + max file size) 3) 20-min enablement demo on streaming/prefix-cache 4) 72-hr watch + snapshot 5) renewals note if no lift. Owner: @Leah.

Leah Park: I'll schedule the triage and draft invite copy. Short invite: "Hi {{name}}, we noticed import failures — 15-min triage + one config tweak often fixes this. Tomorrow 10am PT?"

Tom Hsu: Ops snippet ready for org scope: {"org":"horizon","max_concurrency":"2","max_file_mb":"6","enable_prefix_cache":"true"} I'll stage it.

Nora Bell: Add a reversible bridge option for spend relief: "bridge-throttle" plan — preserves model pins & audit logs, caps throughput for 30 days. Revert with one API call.

cs-bot: Ticket created CS-10177 for Horizon lightweight rehab. Priority: P3. Owner: Tom Hsu.

Samir Desai: Leah — can you produce a 1-paragraph note for the renewals rep explaining intervention and rollback terms? Keep it bulleted.

Leah Park: Yep — will post the one-pager after the triage and add SDR copy into Gainsight.

Tom Hsu: Staged safety config smoke tests pass (50 synthetic imports). Ready to promote post-call and will paste pre/post metrics here.

Samir Desai: Timeline: triage by EOD tomorrow, prod safety change within 3 hours after call if agreed, snapshot at 72 hrs, renewals update 7 days before renewal. If effective, we'll add this compact play to the CS playbook with config snippets and meeting template. :rocket:
